blocks.orig: A hike to the Mount Meru Waterfalls takes 1.5 to 2 hours each way, covering roughly 4 kilometres through forested trails, bubbling streams, and rocky paths. Along the way, an English-speaking guide shares stories about the mountain’s plants, wildlife, and cultural significance. The reward? A waterfall cascading into a quiet pool – cool mist and all. Sturdy hiking shoes are a must, as the climb can be challenging at times.
blocks.html: Walking to the Mount Meru Waterfalls takes 1.5 to 2 hours in each direction, over about 4 kilometres of forest trails, babbling streams and rocky paths. On the way, an English-speaking guide tells you about the mountain’s plants, wildlife and cultural importance. And the reward? A waterfall tumbling into a peaceful pool – complete with cool spray. Good hiking shoes are essential, because the walk can be demanding in places.
